//: Security headers apply to every response, including /api/*.
script-src is strict: the app ships no inline script and calls no eval, so
'self' is the whole policy. That is the directive that actually matters —
it is what turns an injected <script> tag from a working exploit into a
refused one, and this codebase builds HTML from strings.
style-src cannot be strict: index.html carries about twenty style=
attributes (theme swatches, background gradients, display:none defaults) and
kindoku.js emits three more in card markup. Refactoring those to classes is
the better end state but needs visual regression testing this repository has
no way to do. Inline style is a materially smaller risk than inline script,
so the trade is deliberate rather than accidental. budget.test.mjs asserts
'unsafe-inline' is only ever allowed for styles, never for scripts.
frame-src is https: because the reader embeds whatever reading site AniList
linked, which is a different host per title and cannot be enumerated.
frame-ancestors 'none' stops this app being framed for clickjacking, which
is unrelated to what the app itself frames.
img-src allows *.anilist.co because covers are served from s1..s4 depending
on the edge that produced them.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://*.anilist.co; frame-src https:; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
